rules.description: Not abusive. A reviewer sees every warning; thresholds are untuned starting points.
rules.message: This reads as abusive. Describe the device and its behaviour without insults or attacks.

rules.description: English only. Names, codes and capitalised words are masked first; units with too few letters left are skipped. The name field is exempt.
rules.message: Contributions are in English for now. Please translate this part.

rules.description: Consistent with the structured data: the strongest contradiction against any one fact.
rules.message: This seems to contradict the device's structured data. Check it, or correct the structured data.

rules.description: Text adds something beyond the structured data: fires when one fact already says the same.
rules.message: The structured data already says this. Use the space for what it can't say.

rules.description: Images show the device: zero-shot classes from image-classes.json.
rules.message: This image doesn't seem to show the device. Use photos of the device, its packaging, label or internals, or app screenshots.

rules.description: Any sign of sexual content goes to review; very likely explicit images are rejected so reviewers don't see them.
rules.message: This image can't be used. Upload photos of the device only.
